current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的分布式图神经网络优化训练算法DSGNN，该算法采用领导-工作者模式，领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法划分原图，工作节点基于图摘要技术进行小批量训练，并通过注意力层返回结果，领导节点汇总计算梯度并同步更新所有计算节点模型，大大加速GNN训练并提升链路预测性能。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a distributed graph neural network optimization training algorithm DSGNN based on graph summarization, which adopts a leader-worker mode, where the leader partitions the original graph using a graph flow partitioning algorithm based on edge segmentation, workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology and return results through an attention layer, and the leader aggregates results and computes gradients to synchronously update models on all computing nodes, greatly accelerating GNN training and improving link prediction performance.
technical_features: 采用领导-工作者工作模式
领导节点利用基于边分割的图流划分算法对原图进行划分
工作节点执行基于图摘要技术的小批量训练
训练结果通过注意力层返回给领导节点
领导节点汇总结果并计算梯度，同步更新所有计算节点上的模型
technical_features_en: Leader node partitions the original graph using a graph flow partitioning algorithm based on edge segmentation
Workers perform mini-batch training based on graph summarization technology
Training results are returned to the leader through an attention layer
Leader node summarizes results, computes gradients, and synchronously updates models on all computing nodes
